description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring-based Java application for managing bank account operations such as retrieving account details, adding new accounts, transferring funds, and fetching transactions.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: Spring REST controller handling account and transaction related endpoints in the banking application.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch account details based on account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new account for an existing customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to transfer funds between accounts.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all transactions associated with an account.
